verdict.rationale: Ramp documents Funds as budgets with enforced restrictions: amount, interval (daily, monthly, total), allowed merchant categories, merchants and countries. Its spend-controls layer of "budgets, templates, and approval workflows" applies across cards, reimbursements and bills. Marketing pages add pre-spend limit enforcement, team-scoped cards, budget-grounded approval recommendations and rules-based approval routing. missing for 10: explicit evidence of project-level (vs. team) budget allocation and department-level budget rollups, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that limits and approvals actually block over-budget spend.
